title: Trace of (cI + F(·)v) ∘ p_P equals c·dim P + F(p_P v)
statement: Let n, ℓ ∈ ℕ, E = ℝ^{n+ℓ} (Ambient n ℓ), P ⊆ E any linear subspace with orthogonal projection p = p_P (P.starProjection), c ∈ ℝ, F : E → ℝ a continuous linear functional and v ∈ E. Then the endomorphism A = c·I + F(·)v, A(u) = c·u + F(u)·v, satisfies trace(A ∘ p) = c·dim P + F(p v).
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (P : Submodule ℝ (Ambient n ℓ)) (c : ℝ) (F : Ambient n ℓ →L[ℝ] ℝ) (v : Ambient n ℓ), LinearMap.trace ℝ (Ambient n ℓ) ((c • ContinuousLinearMap.id ℝ (Ambient n ℓ) + F.smulRight v).toLinearMap ∘ₗ P.starProjection.toLinearMap) = c * (Module.finrank ℝ P : ℝ) + F (P.starProjection v)
